searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on YouTube, one per line. Each returns the first page of results (about 20 videos).

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel handles or URLs, one per line: @mkbhd, https://www.youtube.com/@veritasium, or a channel URL. Each returns the channel's recent videos (about 30).

videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs
videoUrls.description: Specific videos to get full details for: watch URLs, youtu.be links or bare video ids.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
